account-locked: Woxe mɔ na akɔnta la ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe le gegeɖeme ƒe kpɔkpɔ siwo medze edzi o sɔ gbɔ ta. Taflatse gbugbɔ kpɔ emegbe.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel la le SuperAdmin ko na, le Cloud Panel ƒe domain dzi.
cloud-settings-desc: Le WeKan si le Weddy me la, Cloud Panel naa WeKan domain geɖewo tso server ɖeka dzi, eye wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe kpɔ eƒe nyatakakawo. Le Cloud Panel ƒe domain dzi la, SuperAdmin kpɔa domainwo kple CloudFlare dzi.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ne CloudFlare API safui le asiwò la, domain si ƒe zone le wò CloudFlare akɔnta me la xɔa DNS ŋkɔŋlɔ si to proxy dzi kple CloudFlare Origin kpeɖodzigbalẽ. Domain bubuwo xɔa Let's Encrypt kpeɖodzigbalẽ. Wodzraa safui la ɖo ɖe server dzi eye womegaɖenɛ fiana o.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Womedzra CloudFlare API safui aɖeke ɖo o: domain ɖesiaɖe xɔa Let's Encrypt kpeɖodzigbalẽ.
error-ldap-login: Vodada aɖe va le gege ɖe eme ƒe kpɔkpɔ me
error-notAuthorized: Womena mɔ wò be nàkpɔ axa sia o.
